description: This file implements a class and functions for traversing an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) to identify constant expressions with specific precision qualifiers and hoist them as named variables for correct precision propagation in shader code compilation.

classes.name: RecordConstantPrecisionTraverser
classes.description: A class derived from TIntermTraverser that traverses AST nodes to find constant unions with higher precision qualifiers and hoists them as variables.

methods.name: RecordConstantPrecisionTraverser
methods.description: Constructor initializing the traverser with a symbol table.

methods.name: visitConstantUnion
methods.description: Visits constant union nodes to determine if they should be hoisted based on their precision.

methods.name: nextIteration
methods.description: Resets the internal state for another traversal iteration.

methods.name: foundHigherPrecisionConstant
methods.description: Checks if a higher precision constant has been found during traversal.

methods.name: operandAffectsParentOperationPrecision
methods.description: Determines if a constant operand affects the precision of its parent operation.
